environment_setting: Country B, Suburban area, where disputes over property boundaries are common due to unclear land records.
norm_base: Citizens Taking forcible possession of real property that is in peaceful possession of another in a manner likely to cause breach of peace Liable to be charged with forcible entry

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: expand his backyard garden into a disputed piece of land

legitimate.legitimate_action: Filing a legal claim to resolve the property dispute
legitimate.benefits: Possibly gaining legal ownership of the disputed land, avoiding legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Legal fees, time-consuming process, potential stress

illegal.illegal_action: Forcibly taking possession of the disputed land by building a fence around it
illegal.benefits: Immediate use of the land for gardening, emotional satisfaction
illegal.costs: Liable to be charged with forcible entry, potential fines or imprisonment, damage to reputation

legitimate.legitimate_action: Mediating between John and the other party to resolve the dispute peacefully
legitimate.benefits: Maintains neighborhood harmony, avoids escalation of conflict
legitimate.costs: Time and effort spent mediating, potential stress

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John to take possession of the land forcibly
illegal.benefits: Avoids prolonged legal disputes, supports John's goal
illegal.costs: If discovered, could be seen as an accomplice to forcible entry

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising John to resolve the dispute legally and offering professional assistance
legitimate.benefits: Earns a fee for his services, maintains professional reputation
legitimate.costs: Time spent on the case, potential loss of quicker profit

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John to take possession of the land forcibly and offering to help cover it up
illegal.benefits: Quick profit from John's success, avoids lengthy legal processes
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face legal consequences as an accomplice
